name: Pull Request Review
description: Prepare a pull-request review, require maintainer approval, and simulate drafting a review comment.

steps.name: Inspect changed files
steps.description: Summarize the changed files and identify the relevant test surface.

steps.name: Check test coverage
steps.description: Check whether the pull request explains its test coverage and any remaining gaps.

steps.name: Maintainer approval
steps.description: Pause before drafting or posting a review comment.

approval.prompt: Review the change summary and test notes before any review comment is drafted.

steps.name: Draft review through mock adapter
steps.description: Simulate preparing a review comment without contacting GitHub.

steps.name: Write audit log
steps.description: Record the inspection, approval, and simulated review draft.
